home.description: TrivioQ drops bite-sized, high-quality trivia directly to your device throughout the day. Build your knowledge organically, without dedicating hours to study.

features.heading: Knowledge engineered for the modern attention span

rapidFire.title: Rapid Fire Drops
rapidFire.description: Receive unexpected, high-quality questions delivered right when you least expect them. You have 15 minutes to answer or the drop expires.

smartTailoring.title: Smart Tailoring
smartTailoring.description: Adjust your active windows and category preferences. Our algorithm learns and adapts to your difficulty level to keep you challenged.

globalCompetition.title: Global Competition
globalCompetition.description: Maintain your daily streak and climb the global leaderboards. Challenge your friends to beat your high score and earn bragging rights.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account settings and trivia preferences.
